name: Rail line
description: A railway line's public page: the departure board for a chosen station beside service notices, the line as a strip map, an hour-row timetable for weekdays and weekends, and a fare table.

props.name: defaultStation
props.description: Id of the station shown first: otaru, chikko, asari, zenibako, hoshimi, inazumi, teine, kotoni or sapporo. The station picker in the header, and the stations on the strip map, change the board, the timetable and the fares together.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root. It is at least the height of the viewport and the page scrolls under a sticky header. The board, the clock and the timetable's current hour follow the viewer's clock; dates are fixed in February 2027. Also accepts every other div attribute.
